contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [ CONSTAN]TINVS [IVN NOB C] ; R/ GLOR[IA EXERCITVS]

A worn and incomplete copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine II (AD 317-340), dating to the period c.AD 330-331 (Reece period 17). GLORIA EXERCITVS reverse type depicting Two soldiers standing either side of two standards. Obverse description: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription:[ CONSTAN]TINVS [IVN NOB C]. Reverse description: Two soldiers, two standards. Reverse…
